clue.text: On journey, endures uncovered berth in Asian region

parts.note: to journey is to go
to bide is to endure or wait out, so endures gives bides

indicators.note: uncovered strips the covering letters from each end of the word berth

explanation.surface: A traveller puts up with a bunk with no bedclothes while crossing a part of Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gobi is a vast desert spanning northern China and southern Mongolia, a well-known area of the continent.

clue.text: Golf celebrity abandoning fine sport

parts.note: G is Golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: abandoning says the letter for fine is left out of the word for celebrity

parts.note: celebrity means fame
F is the pencil abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A famous golfer gives up a nice sport.
explanation.definitionFit: A game is a competitive sport or pastime, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Avoided lad on bed with cuddly toy

parts.note: a lad is a boy
a cot is a small bed
a ted is a teddy bear, a cuddly toy

explanation.surface: A boy sleeps in bed clutching a soft toy.
explanation.walkthrough: BOYCOTT comes from Captain Boycott, the Irish land agent shunned by his neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: To boycott is to refuse to deal with, so boycotted means shunned.

clue.text: Drunk cook had claret and bitter food

indicators.note: drunk means the letters of these words have been made unsteady and rearranged

explanation.surface: A tipsy chef swigged red wine and ate something unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Dark chocolate has a high cocoa content and little sugar, giving a bitter taste.

clue.text: Excited uncertainty in South American author's start of epic

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for South
US stands for American, as in US forces
read as author is, i.e. what an author does: he or she pens

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of the word epic

explanation.surface: A South American writer's epic opens with a tense passage.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspense is the anxious, excited state of not knowing what will happen.

clue.text: Perch and carrots perhaps with seconds coming up

indicators.note: in a down entry coming up means this letter rises to an earlier place in the word

parts.note: carrots are an example of root vegetables, so roots

explanation.surface: A fish and some vegetables, with second helpings on the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' lifts the S in ROOTS above the T, giving ROOST. Perch looks like the fish beside carrots; it is a bird's resting place.
explanation.definitionFit: A roost is a place where birds settle to rest, the same as a perch.

clue.text: Partially open a beer

parts.note: a jar is British slang for a glass of beer

explanation.surface: Someone half-opens a bottle of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A door that is ajar stands slightly open, not fully shut.

clue.text: Massive endless vault with nasty smell

indicators.note: endless says the final letter of the word for vault is dropped

parts.note: to vault is to jump
BO is body odour

explanation.surface: An enormous, never-ending cellar reeks.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumbo, from the famous elephant, means very large.

clue.text: Is frightened knight overwhelmed by marauding crusaders?

indicators.note: overwhelmed by puts the knight's letter inside the surrounding letters
marauding crusaders run about wildly, so the word's letters are scattered

parts.note: N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight trembles as raiding crusaders swamp him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marauding' rearranges CRUSADERS, and 'overwhelmed by' sets N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To run scared is an idiom for acting in panic out of fear.

clue.text: Ex-PM: alternatively, former role of Boris

parts.note: Theresa May is a former UK Prime Minister
alternatively means or

explanation.surface: One former prime minister recalls a post another, Boris Johnson, once held.
explanation.walkthrough: Boris Johnson was Mayor of London before he became Prime Minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Before entering Downing Street, Boris Johnson held office as Mayor of London from 2008 to 2016.

clue.text: Gladiator perhaps rashly downs arms

indicators.note: rashly suggests acting carelessly, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A gladiator recklessly lays down his weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Many gladiators fought with blades, so one is an example of a fighter skilled with a sword.

clue.text: Drink gets on chequered surfaces

parts.note: a draught is a swallow of drink
to board a bus or train is to get on it

explanation.surface: Someone's drink ends up spilt on the chessboards.
explanation.definitionFit: A draughtboard is the squared board, in alternating colours, used for the game of draughts (checkers).

clue.text: They organise speakers to go round river vessel

indicators.note: to go round means the speakers' word encloses the other pieces

parts.note: orators are public speakers
R is the map abbreviation for river
a chest is a container, a vessel for holding things

explanation.surface: Organisers arrange for public speakers to tour by river boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go round' puts RCHEST inside ORATORS, just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchestrators arrange and coordinate events or plans, so they are people who organise.

clue.text: Antelope start fight, we heard

definitions.note: antelope can be plural, matching the plural answer

parts.note: to spring is to start up suddenly

indicators.note: we heard says the word for fight is taken by its sound

parts.note: to box is to fight with fists

explanation.surface: Antelopes begin a scrap, so we are told.
explanation.definitionFit: Springboks are a species of southern African gazelle, members of the antelope family.

clue.text: Meal of a sort circulating in large belly

parts.note: a pot or pot belly is a large stomach

indicators.note: circulating moves these letters around into a new order

explanation.surface: Some kind of food is churning round in a big stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot roast is a dish of meat slowly braised in a covered pot, served as a main course.

clue.text: Creature that's scaled high, guy can't say is totally wingless

indicators.note: every one of the four words loses its outer letters, like a body losing its wings

explanation.surface: A scaly beast has climbed up a tree; a man can't say if it has wings.
explanation.walkthrough: Scaled points to climbing; here it means having scales. Stripping each word's ends leaves IG, U, AN and A.
explanation.definitionFit: An iguana is a large tropical lizard, a reptile covered in scales.

clue.text: Reducing din before screening popular movies regularly

indicators.note: screening means the word for before hides the other pieces within it

parts.note: ante is Latin for before
in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word movies

explanation.surface: Cinema noise is cut down before popular films are shown.
explanation.walkthrough: Ante as before is the Latin sense, as in ante-room; 'screening' and 'regularly' are the two indicators, one enclosing, one picking alternate letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Anti-noise is sound generated to cancel unwanted noise, so it lowers a racket.

clue.text: Money for American accommodation

definitions.meaning: an American quarter is a 25-cent coin

explanation.definitionFit: In the US a quarter is a coin worth 25 cents, and quarters also means living lodgings.

clue.text: Among party, soldiers occupying building

parts.note: among means in
a do is a party
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: At a party, troops take over a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Something indoor happens inside a building rather than outside.

clue.text: Blue tit's fancy secondary name

indicators.note: fancy here means elaborately reworked, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A garden bird's elaborate alternative name.
explanation.walkthrough: A blue tit is a small European garden bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A subtitle is a subordinate title beneath the main title of a book or film.

clue.text: Greeting idiot eating more nuts and duck leg

indicators.note: eating means the idiot's word swallows the other piece

parts.note: a goon is a fool
nuts means daft, so more nuts is dafter
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: A fool greets someone while munching more nuts and a duck's leg.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side is also called the on side, so leg gives ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Good afternoon is a polite greeting used after midday.

clue.text: Operation on convulsive movement of eye

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: Surgery on an eye that twitches.
explanation.definitionFit: Optic is an adjective for things relating to vision or the organ of sight.

clue.text: Some retro vehicles in prized collection

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few vintage cars belong to a cherished collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A trove is a store of valuable things, as in treasure trove.

clue.text: Last letter in French is showing enthusiasm

parts.note: Z is the last letter of the alphabet
est is the French word for is

explanation.surface: The final letter of a French word shows keenness.
explanation.definitionFit: Zest means keen relish or energetic eagerness.

clue.text: Going with those people, almost finished travelling

parts.note: a show that is going is on
them refers to those people

indicators.note: almost says the last letter of the word for finished is dropped

parts.note: finished means over

explanation.surface: Leaving with a group, nearly done with the trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on the move is an idiom for travelling from place to place.

clue.text: Lift beams in auditorium

indicators.note: an auditorium is where things are heard, so the word for beams is taken by its sound

parts.note: beams of light are rays

explanation.surface: A stage lift is lit up by spotlights in a theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise something is to lift it higher.

clue.text: I know it's incorrect king is cruel

parts.note: sic is inserted in a quotation to show the error is the original writer's, not the quoter's
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Someone admits an error: the monarch is heartless.
explanation.definitionFit: Sick humour is tasteless and callous, so sick can mean cruel.

clue.text: Tireless gulper, half-cut sibling with wine

indicators.note: half-cut keeps only the back half of the word gulper

parts.note: sis is short for sister
tent is a deep red Spanish wine used in Communion

explanation.surface: A drunk keeps swigging wine with a sister.
explanation.walkthrough: Half-cut is British slang for drunk, which suits the gulper; here it halves the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Persistent means continuing firmly and never giving up.
